boundary: Ports commercial birth-time journey maturity as research-local UI contracts only. No Supabase, credits, auth, queue, or commercial implementation is imported.

contracts.research_requirement: When user opens My Chart/profile form, bottom chat composer must disappear and the form must be centered.
New chat or starter prompt must restore chat mode and composer visibility.
Birth-time rectification result may show candidate ranges and scores, but must not claim birth-time truth.
Research repo may persist local journey/profile state with localStorage only; no Supabase or credit dependency.
Invalid dates, missing time/place, or unparseable choices must produce actionable local UI messages, not silent fake UI.
